title: Tarrant Property Data Profile
eyebrow: Tarrant Appraisal District · Website files and Agent Portal API
intro: Everything Tarrant CAD makes available to us, from two sources: the bulk files downloaded from the CAD website, and the Agent Portal API. For each file or endpoint you get its columns or fields, data types, completeness and value distributions.
foot: Generated {date}. Website files were scanned in full with DuckDB; "Auto-detected on load" is the type DuckDB assigns when it reads the raw file, and distinct counts there are approximate (HyperLogLog). Agent Portal statistics come from the example responses saved in Tarrant-New-Docs.yaml, so they describe a sample. "Data type" is inferred from the values: Code means digits stored as text with leading zeros, so it should stay text. Tokens, passwords, pre-signed links and personal or contact fields are never shown.

notes: Values are fixed-width and padded with spaces in the raw file. Trim before loading or comparing.
Deed_Date uses MM-DD-YYYY; 12-31-1900 is a placeholder, a few hundred rows say N/A, and some dates fall after 2026 (typos). Spec2/Spec3 load as numbers and lose their 000 padding unless read as text.
Values are fixed-width and padded with spaces in the raw file. Trim before loading or comparing.
Deed_Date uses MM-DD-YYYY; 12-31-1900 is a placeholder, a few hundred rows say N/A, and some dates fall after 2026 (typos). Spec2/Spec3 load as numbers and lose their 000 padding unless read as text.

The layout changed from 2025: dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD, Account_Num has no leading zeros (loads as a number), Owner_Zip holds ZIP+4 (76102-6311), MAPSCO is prefixed TAR-, and city/state is written FORT WORTH , TX.
894,814 rows (39%) have no Land, Improvement, Total or Appraised value. 863,653 of those are mineral accounts (RP = M).
286,368 rows have a blank RP code, and Account_Num repeats on 6,685 rows (2,288,133 unique accounts).
Residential detail columns that were filled in earlier years are blank here, including Garage_Capacity, Central_Heat_Ind, Central_Air_Ind and Ag_Acres.

descriptions.RP: Property type: R = residential, C = commercial, P = business personal property, M = mineral.
descriptions.Appraisal_Year: Tax year the values are for.
descriptions.Account_Num: TAD account number. The key that joins the website files to each other and to the Agent Portal pID.
descriptions.Record_Type: Fixed record-type marker in the export layout (always AAAA).
descriptions.Sequence_No: Record sequence within an account; 000 for the main record.
descriptions.Owner_CRRT: Postal carrier route for the owner's mailing address.
descriptions.Situs_Address: Physical location address of the property.
descriptions.Property_Class: TAD property class code (for example A1 single-family, F1 commercial, G1 minerals).
descriptions.TAD_Map: Grid reference on the TAD appraisal map.
descriptions.MAPSCO: MAPSCO street-atlas page and grid for the property.
descriptions.State_Use_Code: Texas Comptroller property category (state code), for example A single-family, C1 vacant lot, F1 commercial.
descriptions.LegalDescription: Legal description: subdivision or survey abstract, block and lot.
descriptions.Notice_Date: Date the appraisal notice was mailed.
descriptions.City: City taxing unit code (000 = not in a city).
descriptions.Num_Special_Dist: How many special taxing districts the account is in.
descriptions.Spec1: First special taxing district code (hospital, college, water, MUD and so on).
descriptions.Deed_Date: Recording date of the most recent deed.
descriptions.Improvement_Value: Market value of buildings and other improvements.
descriptions.Garage_Capacity: Number of cars the garage holds.
descriptions.Year_Built: Year the main building was built.
descriptions.Living_Area: Heated living area in square feet.
descriptions.Swimming_Pool_Ind: X when the property has a swimming pool.
descriptions.ARB_Indicator: Marks accounts with an Appraisal Review Board protest.
descriptions.Ag_Acres: Acres that qualify for agricultural (productivity) valuation.
descriptions.Ag_Value: Productivity value of the agricultural land.
descriptions.Central_Heat_Ind: Y when the building has central heat.
descriptions.Central_Air_Ind: Y when the building has central air conditioning.
descriptions.Structure_Count: Number of structures on the account.
descriptions.From_Accts: Accounts this one was split or merged from.
descriptions.Appraisal_Date: Valuation date (January 1 of the tax year).
descriptions.Appraised_Value: Appraised value after limits such as the homestead cap.
descriptions.GIS_Link: ID linking the account to its GIS parcel.
descriptions.Instrument_No: Recording instrument number of the most recent deed.
descriptions.Overlap_Flag: Marks accounts whose parcel overlaps another account.
descriptions.Gross_Building_Area: Gross building area in square feet.
descriptions.Total_Net_Rentable_Area: Net rentable area in square feet (commercial).
descriptions.AppraisalYear: Tax year the values are for.
descriptions.AccountNumber: TAD account number; joins to Account_Num in Property Data.
descriptions.AgentName: Tax agent appointed on the account.
descriptions.AgentNumber: TAD agent number of the appointed tax agent.
descriptions.Condition: Appraiser's condition rating (for example Average, Good).
descriptions.EYOC: Effective year of construction: the age the building is valued at after updates.
descriptions.NBHD: Appraisal neighborhood the property is valued in.
descriptions.Quality: Construction quality rating (for example Average, Good).
descriptions.SiteName: Name given to the site or property.
descriptions.SiteClassCd: Site class code: the property use the appraisal model treats it as.
descriptions.SiteClassDescr: Description of the site class code.
descriptions.PartyId: TAD ID of the owner party.
descriptions.LastSaleDate: Date of the last recorded sale or transfer (1900-01-01 = unknown).
descriptions.SiteId: TAD site ID for the property location.
descriptions.SitusCity: City where the property is located.
descriptions.NAICSDescr: Description of the business's NAICS industry code.
descriptions.NAICSCd: NAICS industry code of the business.
descriptions.PercentComplete: How complete construction was on January 1, as a percent.
descriptions.NoticeValue: Value shown on the appraisal notice.
descriptions.SubdivisionName: Subdivision or addition the property is in.
descriptions.NumberofStories: Number of stories of the main building.
descriptions.Country: Country of the owner's mailing address.
descriptions.AddressType: Kind of owner mailing address (standard, PO box, foreign).
descriptions.SiteNumber: TAD site number for the property location.
descriptions.TaxYear: Tax year the record is for.
descriptions.Exemption: Exemption granted, with its Texas Tax Code section.
descriptions.ExemptionPct: Share of the value exempted, as a percent (for example 100 for a total exemption).
descriptions.AIN: Alternate identification number built from subdivision, block and lot codes.
descriptions.NeightborhoodCode: Appraisal neighborhood code (the column name is misspelled in the file).
descriptions.MktAdjFactor: Market adjustment factor applied to the neighborhood's values.
descriptions.EffectiveYear: Effective year built, after accounting for remodels and condition.
descriptions.AppraisalMethod: Approach used to value the property: Cost, Income, Override and so on.
descriptions.AssessedValue: Assessed value after limits such as the homestead cap.
descriptions.ASN: Appraisal site number; matches SiteId in the supplemental files.
descriptions.BuildingName: Name of the building on the account.
descriptions.BuildingImprovement: Kind of building (residential single-family, commercial, mobile home and so on).
descriptions.RemodelYear: Year of the last major remodel (0 = none).
descriptions.TotalSqFt: Square footage of this building, feature or basement.
descriptions.NormalDepreciation: Physical depreciation from age, as a percent.

descriptions.ValueAdj: Additional value adjustment factor applied to the building.
descriptions.FeatureImprovement: Kind of secondary improvement (porch, garage, pool, shed and so on).
descriptions.PGIRate: Potential gross income rate per square foot per year.
descriptions.VacancyCollectionLoss: Vacancy and collection loss, as a fraction of potential income (0.10 = 10%).
descriptions.PassThroughIncomeRate: Expense pass-through income per square foot.
descriptions.OperatingExpenses: Operating expenses, as a fraction of income (0.40 = 40%).

descriptions.SiteClass: Site class: the property use the appraisal model treats it as.
descriptions.SubMarketArea: Income sub-market the property is compared within.

descriptions.ImprStyle: Improvement style (warehouse, retail, office and so on).

sources.label: CAD website files
sources.sub: {n} bulk files · every account in the county
sources.desc: Bulk exports downloaded from the Tarrant CAD website, saved in CAD Website/Tarrant. They cover every account in the county.

groups.label: Property Data
groups.desc: The certified property roll, one row per account per year, from output/PropertyData_*.csv.

groups.label: Supplemental
groups.desc: Extra appraisal detail from output/PropertyDataSupplemental_<type>_<year>.csv, split by property type (C, M, P, R). Joins to Property Data on the account number. Pick a year, then a file.

groups.label: Exemptions
groups.desc: Exemptions granted on each account, from Data/PropertyData_Exemptions_<year>.txt. One row per exemption; joins to Property Data on Account_Num.

groups.label: Agent Summary
groups.desc: The Agent Summary export in Data/AgentSummaryData_2024 and Data/AgentSummaryData_2025: ten pipe-delimited UTF-16 text files per year that all join on AccountNumber. Pick a year, then a file.

groups.label: Residential Comp Attributes
groups.desc: Residential comparable-sales attributes from output/<year>ResidentialCompAttributeData.csv, one row per residential account. PIN is the account number.

groups.label: Residential Features
groups.desc: Values of secondary residential improvements: output/<year>ResidentialFeaturesValue.csv for 2024 and 2025, renamed 2026ResidentialImprovementDetails.csv for 2026. Joins to Residential Comp Attributes on PIN.

sources.label: Agent Portal API
sources.desc: Calls available through the TrueProdigy Agent Portal at prod-container.trueprodigyapi.com, documented in CAD Agent Portal/Tarrant New/Tarrant-New-Docs.yaml. They return only the properties we represent, plus protest workflow data the website files lack. Field statistics come from the example responses saved in the docs, so they describe a sample. pID is the CAD account number used in the website files.

about.Office Token: Gets an office token for the Tarrant office. The authorization header is the literal value null.
about.Agent Token: Signs the agent in and returns the user record and the JWT used by every other call.
about.Agent Info: Agent ID, company name and contact name.
about.Agent Summary: Counts of active and expired properties and open and closed appeals for the agent.
about.Agent Profile: The signed-in user's public profile and notification settings.
about.Agent Confrence Configuration: Settings for the virtual hearing (conference) system: greeting, support number and messages.
about.Agent Properties: Every property the agent represents this year, with protest status, deadlines, notice value, recommendation and board order dates. Paged; the body takes filters.
about.Agent Prior Year Appeals: The same property list for prior tax years. Paged; the body takes the same filters.
about.View Current Fiduciary Info: The agent appointment (Form 50-162) on one property: effective and expiration dates and which mailings go to the agent.
about.View Appraisal Notice: Downloads the appraisal notice PDF for a property. The example returned 409 because no notice was available.
about.View Notice of Hearing: Downloads the notice of hearing for a property. The example returned 204 No Content.
about.View Board Order: Returns a link to the ARB board order PDF for a property.
about.View Cad Evidence: Downloads the appraisal district's evidence packet for an appeal.
about.Agent Meetings that need checkin: Formal ARB hearings and docket groups the agent must check in to.
about.Agent Informal Meetings that needs check: Informal meetings the agent must check in to.
about.Case Activity: Timeline of events on one appeal, such as filings, notices, evidence uploads and settlements.
about.Download Activity Attachment: Returns a short-lived download link for a file attached to a case activity.
about.Appoinment of Agent: History of mass Appointment of Agent (AOA) jobs: action, status and property and error counts.
about.Appointment of Agents processed details: Properties inside one mass AOA job, filtered by status.
about.Download Log: History of mass evidence and notice download jobs.
about.Download log Success: Properties that downloaded successfully in one mass download job. Paged.
about.Download log error: Properties that failed in one mass download job, with the error. Paged.
about.Download file of Download Logs: Returns the link to the zip file a mass download produced.
about.Mass Protest History: History of mass protest filing jobs: import type, status, protest and error counts.
about.Mass Protest History Properties: Properties filed in one mass protest job.
about.Mass Protest History Errors: Properties that failed in one mass protest job. The example returned 204 No Content.
